scripts.build: npm run typecheck -w @table-check/core && npm run build -w @table-check/web
scripts.build:dev: npm run typecheck -w @table-check/core && npm run build -w @table-check/web -- --mode development
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:dev && firebase hosting:channel:deploy test --expires 7d -P dev
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules -P dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules -P prod
